news.text: #Wolte Behind #Kolo#Juve is changing#Spalletti's idea: the German giant with the Frenchman[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

"#WOLTE, #KOLO AND MORE CROSSES. LET'S GO, #JUVE!"Starting again with the two forwards used in Vigo. Serena: "They complement each other well. But more balls need to be crossed into the middle..." #Spalletti is starting to consider the double center-forward as an option: not just during the match. The work (including psychological) on #Cambiaso and the discovery of #Sarr: the coach is leveraging the positive aspects. Tomorrow against #Lazio, #Çelik is back. And now #Conceição is at risk...[Front Page TuttoSport]

👀🔛 #Woltemade could start against #Lazio: #Spalletti is evaluating the German in the attacking midfield with Nico #González, behind #KoloMuani, in the 3-4-2-1.[Gianluca Di Marzio via @Juventus_Reborn]

🇩🇪🔛 "The reasoning for #Adzic also applies to #Licina. It remains to be seen whether he will be a key protagonist for #Juventus 2027 or 2028: perhaps next year he will join a mid-to-lower Serie A club to play consistently and get around thirty matches as a starter, but the management has very clear ideas regarding their talents of the future."[Nicolò Schira - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🇲🇪🆙 "#Juventus, clear ideas regarding #Adzic: he will return to Turin at the end of the season. Two Bundesliga clubs have sounded him out, declaring themselves ready to offer around €18M, but the bianconero club will not consider anything less than €25/30M and regards him as one of the protagonists of the future: barring truly sensational offers, they want to hold onto him tightly."[Nicolò Schira - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

💰🆙 Following their second consecutive victory in the Europa League, #Juventus has banked €15.34M so far. The figure includes €4.31M for participation, €10.05M for the Value Pillar, €900,000 for the two wins and approximately €80,000 for the minimum guaranteed league placement. Revenue can still increase based on the results in upcoming matches and their final position in the league phase.[Calcio&Finanza via @juventusinsidernews]

🇵🇹🆗 "The #Conceição case seems to be resolved. #Spalletti showed composure in commenting on the reaction, but he did not appreciate the three slips, highlighting the importance of testing the pitch. The Portuguese helped defuse the controversy and the two definitively cleared the situation face-to-face."[Paolo Aghemo - Sky Sport via @juventusinsidernews]
Good news from la Continassa after #CeltaVigo #Juve#Boga and #Celik are back with the group ahead of the match against #Lazio 🔙✅@junews24com[Marco Baridon]

📊🧐 With #KoloMuani and #Woltemade on the pitch together, #Juve scores a goal every 23 minutes, compared to one every 55 minutes with a single striker. The two number 9s setup is convincing, but it penalized the wingers, with six wide players in the squad.[Gazzetta dello Sport via @Juventus_Reborn]

🇽🇰👀 #Zhegrova is aiming for a starting shirt against #Lazio following his recent positive performances. #Spalletti is evaluating the Kosovar, also due to #Conceição's European fatigue.[TuttoSport via @Juventus_Reborn]

🇳🇱❓ #Koopmeiners continues to be one of #Juventus's most anticipated players. Next year, he will have a balance sheet value of €24M and a salary exceeding €5M until 2029. His positive performance with the Netherlands can be a starting point, but now he must manage to confirm his worth as a bianconero as well.[Andrea Losapio - TuttoJuve via @juventusinsidernews]

🏥 News from the treatment room:🇨🇮 #Boga is close to returning to the pitch, aiming to be back in the squad list as early as Sunday. #Spalletti could regain an important alternative, especially while waiting for #Yildiz's return;🇮🇹 #Ekhator's return, on the other hand, is getting closer. #Juventus aims to have him back between the end of October and the beginning of November, without rushing his timeline. His performance could influence the evaluations regarding the potential signing of a physical striker in January.[TuttoSport via @juventusinsidernews]
